sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed under Sections 437 and 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short, 'the Cr.P.C.') seeking regular bail to the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 in Crime.No.31 of 2024 of Police Station Dahegoan, Kumrambheem Asifabad District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 354D (i), 354A, 365, 366, 366 A, 343, 506, 376 (2)(n) and 109 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 6 and 17 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(v) and 3(2)(va) of SC/ST (POA) Act.

sentences.text:
2. The case of prosecution in brief is that on 28.03.2024 at 7.30 hours, LW.1, who is the father of the victim lodged a complaint stating that petitioner No.1 kidnapped the victim from her home under the pretext of taking her to Rebbena Village at the house of petitioner No.2 and took her to 13 Bn.,
Gudipet and confined her at the Government Police Quarters of accused No.5 and committed sexual intercourse with her several times by putting her under threat and petitioner No.2 and accused Nos.3 and 5 abetted and assisted in the crime and the petitioners and accused Nos.3 to 5 threatened the victim to kill with dire consequences, if she reveals that fact to anyone.
3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 submits that they have not committed any offence as alleged by the prosecution and entire allegations are levelled against other accused.
The petitioners were arrested on 07.04.2024 and since then they have been in jail.
The petitioners were falsely implicated in the present case.
Hence, the petitioners seek for grant of regular bail.
5. Per contra, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that the petitioners and other accused persons have committed grave offence and investigation is under progress.
At this juncture, the petitioners are not entitled for grant of bail.

6. Having considered the rival submissions made by the respective parties and after perusal of the material available on record, it reveals that the petitioners and other accused kidnapped a minor girl and wrongfully assaulted and the petitioners committed rape on her.
It is also brought to the notice of this Court that accused No.5 filed Crl.P.No.5313 of 2024 before this Court and the same was dismissed as withdrawn on 09.05.2024.

Apart from the above, the allegations levelled against the petitioners are serious in nature and as the investigation is not yet completed, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 at this stage.
